integrity.computation_scope: Reproducible finite tests and independent LP through n=10; they are not substitutes for analytic proof.
integrity.historical_priority: provisional; relevance of earlier extreme-ray papers bounded by accessible bibliographic evidence
integrity.proof_scope: All integers n>=3, via explicit simplex barycentric coordinates and affine dual-gradient norm computations.

scientific_limitations: Applies only to normalized nonnegative hollow symmetric Monge matrices with the intrinsic Frobenius metric and integer matrix order at least three.
Excludes non-hollow symmetric matrices, nonsymmetric Monge matrices, alternate metrics and unnormalized cones.
No independent mathematical audit and no claim of exhaustive historical priority.
title: The Frobenius incenter of every hollow symmetric Monge simplex is Toeplitz and tends to quadratic cost
